title: Critique: the cellular findings come from few regions and species

statements.text: Apical amplification and its regulation by arousal have been shown only in a few regions of a few species and at late stages of development, and the heterogeneity across regions and species is only beginning to be mapped.

sources.quote: it is only in a few regions of a few species and at late stages of ontogenetic development that AA and arousal-dependent regulation of Ih-currents have been shown to occur
